svg.text: Matched filtering is not enough by itself. You still need to sample near the center of the eye, where the current symbol is strongest and neighbors cancel.
1. Same matched-filter output, three different sampling phases
2. Eye-diagram view: the best sample sits at the widest opening
Too early or too late still lands on the right waveform, just not at the best decision instant.
The eye opening is widest at the centered instant. That is why timing recovery tries to keep the sampler there instead of drifting across the slopes.
